Interdisciplinary Projects (IDP)

General Information

The Department of Operations Management offers interdisciplinary projects at regular intervals. The guidelines laid down by TUM School of Computation, Information and Technology can be found here or on their website

If we do not currently have any interdisciplinary projects, we are happy to take initiative applications as well.

Application Procedure and Contact

Please send your applications as well as all inquiries to Aziz Boushih including the following application documents:

  • Tabular CV
  • Certificate of University entrance qualification
  • Full transcript of records (Bachelor and Masters)
  • Detailed description of your programming skills
